newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela lists 14 bidders for Consolidado.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela lists 14 bidders for Consolidado.

text.p: Venezuela's State Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade announced Monday that 14 potential bidders had qualified to participate in the sale of state bank Banco Consolidado.
The 14 are led by Spain's Banco Santander and France's Banque Paribas.

Other bidders are the Netherlands' Enhobel PLC, Banponce Corp of Puerto Rico, a group led by Colombia's Banco de Bogota, General Electric Capital Corp, Chile's Infisa CA, Venezuelan investment bank Fivenez and leading Venezuelan bank Banco Mercantil CA SACA.
Banco Canarias, Banco Cuzcatlan SA, Banco del Caribe, Bancol y Cia and Consorcio Inversionista Bancaracas SACA make up the rest of the list.
Fogade has not yet announced a firm date for the Banco Consolidado sale.
Consolidado is one of many banks taken over by the government during a 1994-5 financial sector crisis.
The government has said it will reserve about 10 percent of the bank's stock for sale via the local stock exchange.
